description_en: Creates a load balancing instance by calling the CreateLoadBalancer operation
description_zh: 调用CreateLoadBalancer接口创建负载均衡实例
kebab_example: aliyun ens create-load-balancer --ens-region-id cn-chengdu-telecom --load-balancer-spec elb.s2.medium --pay-type PostPaid --network-id n-5sax03dh2eyagujgsn7z90000 --vswitch-id vsw-5s78haoys9oylle6ln71m0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateLoadBalancer

parameters.help_en: The ID of the ENS edge zone
parameters.help_zh:
ENS节点ID。

并非所有 ENS 节点都支持创建 ELB；调用前请确认目标节点已开通该能力
parameters.name: ens_region_id

parameters.help_en: The specification of the load balancing instance
parameters.name: load_balancer_spec

parameters.help_en:
The name of the load balancing instance. The name must be 1 to 80 characters in length and can contain letters and Chinese characters. If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically assigns an instance name.

The name cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
负载均衡实例的名称，长度为1~80个英文或中文字符。不指定该参数时，由系统随机分配一个实例名称。

不能以`http://`和`https://`开头
parameters.name: load_balancer_name

parameters.help_en: The billing type. PostPaid (currently the only supported type): pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh: 付费类型。PostPaid（目前只支持此种）：按量付费
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en: The network ID of the Edge Load Balancing (ELB) instance to create
parameters.help_zh: 创建的边缘负载均衡（ELB）实例的网络ID
parameters.name: network_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch to which the VPC instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 专有网络实例的所属的交换机ID
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
Ensures the idempotency of the request to avoid duplicate operations caused by multiple retries.
Generate a parameter value from your client and ensure that the value is unique across different requests. The ClientToken value supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

If you use a ClientToken that has been used before and the other request parameters remain unchanged, the client receives the same result as the first submission, with no impact on your server-side state.

You can retry when the API times out or returns the PROCESSING error code, and idempotency takes effect. If the return result is an HTTP 200 status code, the retry returns the same result as the previous call with no impact on your server-side state. If the return result is an HTTP 4xx status code and the error code is not PROCESSING, idempotency does not take effect.
The ClientToken is valid for 10 minutes
parameters.help_zh:
保证请求幂等性，避免多次重试带来重复操作的问题。
从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII 字符，且不能超过 64 个字符 。

当您使用了一个已经使用过的ClientToken，其他请求参数无变化，那么重复提交该请求后，客户端将收到与首次提交相同的结果，对您的服务端状态没有影响。

在接口超时或者错误码为PROCESSING的时候可以发起重试，幂等有效。返回结果是200 HTTPCode时，重试后客户端可以得到与上次相同的结果，但对您的服务端状态没有影响；返回结果是4xx HTTPCode时，且错误码不是PROCESSING则幂等无效。
ClientToken有效期为10分钟
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The billing cycle of the ELB instance
parameters.name: billing_cycle

parameters.help_en:
The type of the Edge Load Balancing instance.

CLB: Classic Load Balancing instance.
InternetDR: Public pattern load balancing instance
parameters.help_zh:
边缘负载均衡实例类型。

CLB：传统型负载均衡实例
InternetDR：公网模式负载均衡实例
parameters.name: load_balancer_type

LoadBalancerName.description_en: The name of the load balancing instance
